name: Independence Premium Foods
old_description: We don't just run your recipe. We co-manufacture, co-invest, and build what's next.
about:
Independence Premium Foods (IPF) operates a USDA-licensed premium food co-manufacturing facility in Independence, Iowa. The company serves brand partners that require USDA certification and legally defensible quality claims for human-grade food products. Its central U.S. location is positioned to support national distribution networks, and the facility is described as built for brands ready to scale.

The facility encompasses approximately 131,000 square feet and provides more than 200 million pounds of annual production capacity. IPF offers co-manufacturing and co-investment services, managing production runs for brands seeking to scale without building their own plants. The company emphasizes that it does not simply run recipes but engages in collaborative development.

Customers are typically food brands that need human-grade manufacturing under USDA inspection. The company does not disclose specific client names but emphasizes its ability to deliver legally defensible quality claims, which suggests a focus on regulated product categories such as ready-to-eat meals, pet food, or specialty proteins.

IPF describes its model as going beyond traditional toll manufacturing by co-investing with partners and collaborating on product development. The company’s stated mission is to co-manufacture, co-invest, and build what’s next for the brands it works with.
